text:
Test Case ID: TC_01
Title: Register
Description: Verify the register account functionality of Hotel Reservation Prereq: User should not be registered before by same account
Steps: Enter first name Enter last name Select gender Enter email Enter phone number Create Password Enter confirm Password
Expected Result: Full name entered Last name entered Gender selected Email entered Phone number entered Password created Password re-entered

Test Case ID: TC_02
Title: Login
Description: Verify the login functionality of online Hotel Reservation

Test Case ID: TC_03
Title: Search Hotel
Description: Verify the search hotel items functionality of system Prereq: User has login to the account successfully
Steps: Enter search Hotel Search nearest Hotels
Expected Result: Hotels displayed Nearest hotels displayed

Test Case ID: TC_04
Title: Select Hotel
Description: Allow user to select hotel Prereq: User has already registered with the system Prereq: User has login to the account successfully.
Steps: Enter User name Enter password Select desired hotel Hotel selected
Expected Result: User name entered Password entered

Test Case ID: TC_05
Title: Check Room Availability
Description: Verify the check room availability of hotel Prereq: User must select hotel first.
Steps: Click room’s availability Choose No. of rooms
Expected Result: Available rooms displayed Rooms selected

Test Case ID: TC_06
Title: Confirm Booking
Description: To allow user to confirm booking Prereq: User must booked rooms and enter valid details about
Steps: Enter confirm booking Select done
Expected Result: All details displayed Booking confirmed

Test Case ID: TC_07
Title: Cancel Booking
Description: To allow user to cancel booking Prereq: User must firstly booked rooms before cancelling.
Steps: 1 Select cancel booking Booking canceled

Test Case ID: TC_08
Title: Store Customer’s Detail
Description: Verify the store customer detail functionality Prereq: User must booked rooms.
Steps: Check details Edit details Store customer details
Expected Result: Details displayed Details edited Details stored

Test Case ID: TC_09
Title: Receive Confirmation Message
Description: Verify the confirmation of booking Prereq: User has Booked rooms
Steps: Check confirmation message Booking confirmed

Test Case ID: TC_10
Title: Make Payment
Description: Allow user to make payment Prereq: Confirmed booking
Steps: Enter Payment Method. Enter Credit Card details. System checked credit card details. Valid Payment Method selected. Valid credit card details entered. If Credit card details are wrong, rejected otherwise accepted.

Test Case ID: TC_11
Title: Generate Report
Description: Verify the register account functionality of gym management Prereq: Booking is confirmed
Steps: Enter CNIC If foreigner, enter passport number Enter customer signature CNIC entered Passport no. entered Signature entered

Test Case ID: TC_12
Title: Forget Password
Description: Verify the forget password selection functionality of gym Prereq: User has entered wrong password or has forgotten the
Steps: Enter Wrong Password Click Forgot Password link Wrong password entered
Expected Result: Link opened Enter your email and create a new password
